instruction: Open Obsidian and append "- remember to file the reimbursement" at the end of the note "Inbox/Thursday Scratchpad.md".

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Thursday Scratchpad

- buy tea
- reply to Sam
'); obsidian-cli create "Inbox/Thursday Scratchpad.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: content=$(printf '%b' '- remember to file the reimbursement'); obsidian-cli create "Inbox/Thursday Scratchpad.md" --content "$content" --append --vault "Benchmark"
